description: TEST preview for original Maps Automotive 26.10.120001.E (1068833407, ARM64). Adds an optional instrument-cluster map without opening Maps, the battery reader waking right after the car is switched on, and cluster turn hints for the DiLink 3 adapter. Includes all preview 4 features. MicroG-RE 7.2.1 tested; own signing key required. For 26.09.280001.E use preview 3. See release notes for setup and verification limits.
